name: TileRule
doc: First matching rule wins. Masks use GridLayout::neighbors bit order; a neighbor "matches" when its tile's definition has the rule's terrain.

fields.name: required
fields.doc: Neighbors which must share this terrain.

fields.name: forbidden
fields.doc: Neighbors which must not share this terrain.

fields.name: tile
fields.doc: Output tile number; its definition must have the same terrain.
